reviews.t: Perfect addition for husband as a barrier between his bald head and CPAP machine straps.
reviews.x: My husband actually uses this as a barrier between his head and his CPAP mask strap. It absorbs the oils from his bald head which keeps his mask straps much clearer and it is much easier to wash the du-rag every couple nights than the mask straps! Time saver and cleaner alternative than wearing g a CPAP mask directly on the skin surface!

reviews.t: but the lay it puts on your waves is really good. Buy multiple because they will rip
reviews.x: Been waving for over 15 years. For those who are looking for a silky du rag, I've purchased these after attempting to buy others with the same name. The difference is, you have to see the thick and smooth on the picture. They do rip after a while, but the lay it puts on your waves is really good. Buy multiple because they will rip. Kinda like a run in a pair of panty hoes. Don't go buy the $20 ones you see on IG.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the silky, comfortable material and say it helps produce shiny, well-laid waves.
Several reviewers report the durag rips or falls apart after a short time, with seams and threading coming apart.
Some reviewers complain the quality has declined, receiving thin, cheap, see-through material instead of the advertised smooth and thick fabric.
A few reviewers note the straps are too short to tie in the back, and some say it fits small heads better than normal-sized ones.
Some reviewers recommend buying multiple spares, either because they may rip or get lost.
